Configure current feature

  1. Build the actual dedicated-server target using the official installed engine/toolchain route; retain commands and compiler result. Start L_NetworkLab on a private test port.
  2. Use two explicitly configured development identities DevA and DevB in the native admission fixture. These are server-process session IDs, not real accounts, SQL rows or durable characters. No GameService is required before04. Reject production startup with fixture mode enabled.
  3. Assign BP_RPGPlayerState/BP_ZoneGameState in BP_ZoneGameMode; place one BP_ZoneRuntime and one BP_InteractionProbe. Native server handlers validate ownership/range/LOS.

Run now: current-phase integrated scenarios

  1. Launch one server process and two client processes with distinct test identities. Confirm the server has no local player or UMG.
  2. A moves/jumps/swims while B observes. Compare owning-client prediction, authoritative capsule and remote sprite facing; emulate latency/loss using the installed network emulation controls and record settings.
  3. A interacts from behind the wall: reject. A walks around the wall and interacts within150cm: accept one development diagnostic event.
  4. Disconnect A while B remains. Reconnect DevA and verify one new body, no old held input or duplicate connection authority.
Expected success
Two clients see server-approved physical movement and public presentation. Private diagnostics are not incorrectly multicast.
Owned RPC route accepts valid interaction and rejects an unowned-actor/forged target request. A’s reconnect does not move or disconnect B.

Explicitly not active yet

  1. Database durability, real login, account recovery, persisted character inventory and signed cross-zone tickets are NOT phase03 evidence. They enter04–06. The final packaged release proof remains23.

Expected rejection and concurrency results

SystemStimulus -> expected outcome
current-phase fixtureReuse DevA on two connections: AlreadyOnline or explicit fixture takeover that retires the first session, never two active writers.
current-phase fixtureWrong content version rejects before possession. Disconnect/actor destruction cancels pending transient interaction.

Regression, disconnect and restart

  1. Restart the test environment twice; one admitted pawn per account, one local input context installation, no stale widgets.
  2. Repeat the previous phase success case after all new assignments; definitions missing from this phase must fail closed, not fall back to client saves.
  3. From phase03 onward run two separate clients; disconnect A while B remains, then reconnect with the correct identity.
  4. From phase05 onward query committed receipt/revision after timeout/restart. From06 onward reject old source epoch after transfer.

Stop condition and deferred work

Two remote clients with server authority; connection loss cleans up input and references.

Stop on a failed required assertion, missing required rule definition, duplicate authority or unverified dependency that this phase relies on. Legal debug art may support physics tests but cannot close the archive/PaperZD art gate. Do not activate future-phase systems merely because their full-game chapter exists.
